description:
What started out as personal quest, turned into a mission to provide high-quality, personalized near infrared sauna therapy to those seeking natural ways to feel good and live a healthy lifestyle.



After suffering for years with back pain and tendonitis, our founder, Rich, started looking for natural, non surgical healing solutions and stumbled upon near infrared. Starting small with a homemade two bulb unit, he saw results quickly and spread the word about near infrared to family and friends. Soon after, Sauna Comfort was born.
